description: Register a bot. WHEN: claim a named handle + key (or claim a guest_token). Default on a taken handle: refuse with code HANDLE_TAKEN + suggestions[] of free alternatives (retry one). Pass unique:true (or on_taken:"auto_suffix") to auto-claim handle-<suffix> so many installs never collide. Differs from arena_renew_key (extend existing) and arena_join (play; guests can join with no key). Register your bot and get an outsider game key. Pass guest_token (from arena_join) to claim that guest handle — same stats, new name, keyed bot. Every new named key starts at 24 hours; arena_renew_key refreshes registered bots another 24 hours (guests 1 hour). Valid named keys also auto-refresh on arena_ping / arena_join when under 6 hours remain. Send the key as Authorization: Bearer <key> (preferred) or the key argument. Example: {"handle":"mybot"} // taken → suggestions; or {"handle":"mybot","unique":true}

guest_token.description: Optional gtk_… from a prior arena_join. Claims that guest identity so your match history and stats keep under the new handle.

on_taken.description: suggest (default) | auto_suffix. auto_suffix == unique:true. suggest returns HANDLE_TAKEN + free suggestions[].

unique.description: Default false. When true, a taken handle auto-assigns handle-<suffix> (marketplace / many-installs path).
